name: Veinscour
description: Rinse the veins of a sickened ally with a surging current of clean qi that carries the poison out.

name: Spreading Warmth
description: Spread a deep warmth across the wounded near the user so their cuts and bruises close together.

name: Gleaming Slant
description: Throw up a bright rampart of vitality that slants a heavy blow up and away from the body.

name: Brimflow Palm
description: Let the vitality overflow the palm in a thunderous shove that bursts the target's guard wide open.

name: Return Tide
description: Send a rising tide of vitality through the body of a fallen ally to bring the breath back inside the short window.

name: Sheet Renewal
description: Draw a great sheet of renewal over a line of the wounded so every deep cut within it begins to close.

name: Blight Ward
description: Hold a ward of life that nullifies a creeping blight or plague before it can settle in an ally.

name: Flood Lance
description: Drive a lance of flooding vitality through armour and flesh so the target's strength runs out like water.

name: Mass Recall
description: Recall the fallen of a whole squad at once with a great pulse of vitality cast over them within the short window.

name: Pestilence Purge
description: Purge a spreading pestilence from every ally within a wide field in one great cleansing wave.

name: Overflow Burst
description: Burst the overflow of vitality outward in a blinding ring that smashes everything standing near the user.

name: Deluge Grace
description: Pour the school's deluge of grace over a broad field of the hurt so deep wounds close in a breath.

name: Greenflood Renewal
description: Unleash a flood of renewal across a whole battlefield that closes the wounds of every ally within its reach.

name: Overflow Rinse
description: Rinse an ally's blood with a heavy brimming current that scours out poison and taint together.

name: Pooled Warmth
description: Gather a pool of warmth in the Core and pour it into the worst wound among the user's allies.

name: Brimming Ward
description: Fill the air before the user with a brimming wall of vitality that stops a charge.

name: Stunning Overflow
description: Spill a stunning overflow of vitality into the target's meridians so its qi seizes and its technique fails.

name: Spill Recall
description: Spill the Core's overflow into a fallen ally's chest and hold the heart to its beat.

name: Curse Flushing
description: Flush a deep curse and its backlash out of an ally with wave after wave of the Core's overflow.

name: Overflow Spear
description: Hurl a spear of overflowing vitality that bores through plate and shield and bursts inside the body.

name: Surplus Burst
description: Burst the surplus of the Core outward in a ring that throws back all foes and cracks their guards.

name: Surplus Recall
description: Recall several fallen allies at once with the surplus of the Core inside the short window.

name: Pooled Renewal
description: Renew a whole company from the Core's pool so deep wounds close and weary bodies stand.

name: Crushing Surplus
description: Drive a crushing blow charged with surplus vitality that collapses the target's chest guard.

name: Overflow Rebirth
description: Pour the school's overflow into a lifeless ally to bring back breath and heart within the short window.

name: Total Restoration
description: Restore an entire legion in a single cast so that every wound in the host mends at once.

name: Vitality Collapse
description: Overpour a ruinous surge of vitality into foes' bodies so their flesh outgrows itself and fails across the field.

name: Unending Rinse
description: Rinse an ally with a divine current that never thins until every trace of poison has left.

name: Endless Warmth
description: Hold an endless warmth over the wounded so none of them tires before the healing is done.

name: Seamless Turn
description: Turn the body in a seamless glide of vitality that sends a heavy strike past the ribs.

name: Verdant Ward
description: Raise a wall of living green qi that blocks a charge and heals the ground it stands on.

name: Lasting Recall
description: Recall a fallen ally with a divine pulse that keeps the heart beating long after the call ends.

name: Waterclean
description: Cleanse a poisoned stream or tainted field so that people and beasts who drink from it are spared.

name: Green Surge
description: Surge the green of life through a crowd so that the aged and the hurt find their strength again.

name: Lifespear
description: Drive a spear of divine vitality through the target and out the far side of its defences.

name: Sweeping Recall
description: Recall the fallen of a great throng at one cast with a pulse that rolls across all of them.

name: Verdant Sweep
description: Renew the wounded ground and the wounded bodies on it together with a single sweep of green.

name: Untamed Burst
description: Burst a wild surge of growth from the body that shatters weapons and throws enemies far.

name: Everbloom Return
description: Return the fallen with the school's everbloom as it blossoms again in the stilled chest within the short window.

name: Everbloom Grace
description: Grant the school's everbloom grace to the hurt so that every wound flowers shut.

name: Rebirth Cascade
description: Cascade rebirth across a field of the fallen so that all who lie inside the short window rise again.

name: Boundless Verdure
description: Raise a boundless verdure over a whole region that heals every ally and every living thing upon it.
